title: Hoshino Ichika — Beyond The Sky〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. So this is where Ichi works, then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but...are we really going to do this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After we've already tailed her all the way here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What are we waiting for? Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, today was actually pretty tiring...
Or should I say, surprising.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I saw you three coming over with those smug grins on your faces when I took over the cash register...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry for not telling you in advance.
We decided to make it a surprise visit after some discussion.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I've always wanted to see what your workplace looked like.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's just so hard to imagine you serving customers.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And when we tried to order a smile to go along with, you completely ignored us too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Nobody makes an order like that anymore these days...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I really wanted a smile from you!
Pretty please with a cherry on top?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't take orders outside working hours.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's put all of that aside and go meet Miku and Luka like we promised, okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, all of you came together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! Oh, and there's something we'd like you to know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've decided to continue playing in a band together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. We already have a name for our band too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Fantastic! What's your band name then?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's Leo/need.
We based it on the Leonids meteor shower that we saw together in the past.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But why is there a slash in the middle?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I fully intend to give this band my all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to make lots of great memories with everyone and enjoy our time in high school together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Super! You have my full support.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI, Luka, and myself...we share the same feelings as you. So feel free to come any time you want and turn to us for any help at all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm like your senior classman here, after all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Miku, let's get ready for practice!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Looks like we're wanted.
Well then, let's have some fun together today too, Ichika!
